summary: fractal-test's --time-limit for a scripts/ci-local check (linux-gate) counts only from ci-local's own start: the build admission of its nix develop and the dev shell before it are waiting, bounded only by 30 minutes without any output, and the wait is shown in the row and recorded in the note as pre_start_s; evidence-wrap now passes a command's output on as it comes instead of in 64 KiB blocks

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes; a note gains one more input (pre_start_s), which no policy reads.

rules.detail: What is signed and how the gate judges it are unchanged; output_sha256 is the digest of the same bytes.

compatibility.detail: A linux-gate run no longer times out while it waits to start (one lost a run whose tests had passed). A check silent for 30 minutes before ci-local starts is stopped as timed out. evidence-wrap reads its command's output with read1, so callers see it promptly. Both scripts are read from the base, so this applies to every branch once it merges.
